content.text: /ext:medcp Which antihypertensive classes are most commonly prescribed in adults 40-60?

I'll query the OMOP clinical database to find the most commonly prescribed antihypertensive drug classes in adults aged 40-60. Let me start by identifying the relevant drug concepts and their mapping to classes.

arguments.sql_query:
-- Step 1: Identify antihypertensive drug concepts and their standard names/specialty_drug_class
SELECT 
    c.concept_id,
    c.concept_name,
    c.vocabulary_id,
    c.domain_id,
    cc.class_name as concept_class,
    c.standard_concept
FROM omop.concept c
JOIN omop.concept_class cc ON c.concept_class_id = cc.concept_class_id
WHERE LOWER(c.vocabulary_id) IN ('rxnorm', 'ndc')
  AND c.standard_concept IS NOT NULL
  AND c.invalid_reason IS NULL
  AND (
    LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%antihypertensive%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%angiotensin%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ACE inhibitor%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ACEi%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ARB%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%angiotensin receptor%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beta blocker%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beta-blocker%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%beta adrenergic blocker%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%calcium channel blocker%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%diuretic%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%thiazide%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%loop diuretic%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%aldosterone antagonist%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%spironolactone%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%eplerenone%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%clonidine%'
    OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%alpha blocker%'
  )
ORDER BY c.concept_name
LIMIT 50;
